definitions.divergence: angle between executed direction and the BC-parent direction at the same state > 10.0 deg
definitions.pursuit_evasion_pursuit: pursuit steps (angle to line of sight <= 10 deg) before the closest approach, deviating steps while the defender is visible, pursuit steps afterwards, episode captured
definitions.resume: mean cos(executed direction, line of sight) after the closest defender approach >= 0.95
